blockers.description: Reopen evidence: the DoD requires "cold storage migration thresholds". The page and router are real and wired (PR #626) over the existing DocumentRetentionPolicy model (retention days, auto-archive, legal-hold override), but no cold-storage threshold exists in the model, validators or UI; the attestation itself says "UI-only scope".
To close: cold-storage migration thresholds exist in the model, validators and UI with tests (or the owner amends the DoD to drop them); then Completed.
